Study options

Aalto offers five study options in Science and Technology at Bachelor’s level

In 2018, Aalto University introduced an English-medium Bachelor’s Programme in Science and Technology. Today, the programme is fully running with five study options and more than 120 students representing 20 nationalities.

The Aalto Bachelor’s Programme in Science and Technology leans on the long tradition of Aalto University in educating top-level experts in the field of science and technology. In addition to a strong focus on mathematical and computational technology methods, the programme also guarantees its students a robust skill-set in information technology. It provides students with a bachelor’s degree in technology as well as a solid basis for further studies at the master’s level.

Currently, about two thirds of the programme’s students come from abroad and one third from Finland, indicating that there is a strong drive among Finnish students to study in an international environment already at Bachelor’s level. The application period to the programme is 8 – 22 January 2020 (first application period of the spring joint application). Information and instructions are available here.
